mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS id, o.event_label AS name, o.event_code AS eventCode, o.category AS category, o.icon AS icon, o.status AS status, o.use_count AS useCount, o.default_amount AS defaultAmount, o.sort_order AS sortOrder FROM gift_event_type_option_t o WHERE o.user_id = 0 AND o.option_type = 'SYSTEM' AND o.is_delete = 0 ORDER BY o.sort_order ASC, o.event_code ASC

SELECT o.id FROM gift_event_type_option_t o WHERE o.is_delete = 0 AND ( (o.option_type = 'SYSTEM' AND o.user_id = 0 AND o.event_code = #{eventType}) OR (o.option_type = 'CUSTOM' AND o.org_id = #{orgId} AND o.event_label = #{eventType}) ) ORDER BY o.last_used_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM gift_event_type_option_t o WHERE o.user_id = 0 AND o.option_type = 'SYSTEM' AND o.event_code = #{eventCode} AND o.is_delete = 0
